records.name: beret-front
records.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is a six-view design board of ONE mist lavender felt beret. Create a SINGLE high-resolution square front orthographic product image of that exact beret, matching the board's TOP LEFT front view. Only the hat, no cat, no stand, no labels, no collage. Crown broad, softly domed and generously full, modest asymmetric droop toward viewer right, narrow softly rolled lower band with one broad relaxed fold above it; short upright felt stalk on top. Preserve muted lavender wool color but replace exaggerated swirly tangled fibers with restrained fine dense felt grain. Silhouette smooth and plush, real cloth thickness, no stiff disk or pointed crown. Even diffuse all-around illumination, no cast shadow or floor shadow, uniform very pale neutral gray background. Entire hat centered, same head-on camera at band height, width occupies 78% of square with generous margin. Do not expose interior from this front view. This is the master front image for multi-view 3D reconstruction; faithfully preserve shape and topology. Output one image only, no text.

records.name: scarf-front
records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: master FRONT image for a modular 3D scarf accessory for a small plump white kitten mascot. Create ONE isolated powder ice-blue wool scarf in its natural WORN SHAPE, around an invisible broad oval neck/chest. NO kitten, NO mannequin, NO neck or support. A soft continuous wide oval loop, taller at back and sagging gently at the front, a few broad diagonal fabric folds, softly rounded substantial cloth edges. A modest relaxed slip knot sits to the VIEWER RIGHT of center, two unequal hanging ends descend from that knot on the viewer-right side, the longer end with a soft S-curve and gentle twist, the shorter end partially behind it; both ends have small rounded short tassel bundles. Keep center/left below the loop completely OPEN, not a garment/bib or poncho. Fine understated knitted V stitches in the same pale blue tone, no contrasting print, no hard belt or cylindrical tube, no sharp origami creases, no rigid flat strips. Delicate toy-scale fabric thickness, readable soft folds. Total width about 1.2 times total height including ends; oval neck opening physically empty. Front orthographic product view at slightly above band height so the empty opening is visible, smooth stylized premium 3D render. Even soft all-around illumination; no cast shadow, no ground plane, no strong baked shading. Uniform very pale neutral gray backdrop, single complete scarf centered with margins, no labels or text, square high resolution. Final purpose is fitting on a chubby cat's shoulders while leaving its face and paws clear.

One isolated accessory in worn shape, square, centered generous margins, pale neutral gray background, even diffused lighting without cast shadows, no text, no collage, no support.
